subject: Discovery recap and pilot kickstart plan — Bluehaven Analytics
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@bluehaven.ai>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@bluehaven.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap and pilot kickstart plan — Bluehaven Analytics

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap and a proposed pilot kickstart so we can move to scheduling and access.

Key pain points you raised
- Inconsistent latency on peak load (spikes up to ~900ms for the extraction endpoint) leading to UX errors
- Cost unpredictability when model usage spikes (billing variance across runs)
- Extraction hallucinations: downstream QA flags ~12% of labeled records as incorrect

Goals we captured
- 95th percentile latency < 200ms for interactive flows
- Unit inference cost reduction ~40% vs current baseline
- Extraction F1 >= 0.92 on your labeled holdout

Proposed pilot scope (3-week sprint)
1) Endpoints: (A) Document extraction pipeline (batch + low-latency verification API) (B) Summarization/chat assist for analyst workflows
2) Baseline: run your current model calls over a 48h baseline to capture latency/cost profiles
3) Optimization & tuning: batching, quantization profile, prompt/eval rounds and caching configuration
4) Eval: prompt set (200 labeled samples) + automatic regression checks and human spot-checks

Owners
- Bluehaven: Alex Morgan (PM) — primary decision maker; Priya Desai (Data Eng) — dataset & infra access
- Redwood: Ben Carter (sales lead), Kimberly Park (solutions/engineering lead), Rishi Malhotra (inference lead)

High-level timeline
- By May 28: provide sample dataset + temporary S3 read link & service account; whitelist Redwood egress IPs
- Week 1 (May 31–Jun 4): baseline collection & performance profiling
- Week 2 (Jun 7–11): tuning and prompt/eval iterations
- Week 3 (Jun 14–18): final eval, metrics review, and decision meeting

Access/setup checklist (initial)
- Temporary IAM service account with s3:GetObject on s3://bluehaven-samples/poc/
- VPN or IP allowlist window (we can provide static egress IPs)
- Sample prompt/eval format (CSV with id, prompt, expected) — Priya, a small example CSV will help us align quickly

Attachments I’m sending: BH-poc-charter-template.pdf, BH-mutual-action-plan.xlsx. I also linked the HubSpot deal in case your procurement/legal teams want to reference the commercial framework.

Immediate asks
- Can you confirm owners and the sample dataset timeline (by May 28)?
- Are there security/compliance contacts we should loop in now?
- Proposed kickoff: Wed May 26 at 10:00 AM PT — if that doesn’t work, I’ve suggested alternatives below.

Next steps: once we have dataset and access window we’ll provision a sandbox deployment and run the baseline. I’ll loop Kim and Rishi for technical onboarding on the kickoff.

Thanks — look forward to getting started.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@bluehaven.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@bluehaven.ai>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@bluehaven.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap and pilot kickstart plan — Bluehaven Analytics

Thanks Ben — solid recap and aligned on the goals. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Security/compliance: please send a brief SOC 2 summary and any data handling/retention defaults for the sandbox. Our legal lead Tom is CC’d and will want that before we provide broad dataset access.
2) Data: we can deliver the 200 labeled prompt/eval sample by May 27; full sample data (up to 10k rows) will be available by May 28 behind our S3 with a short-lived role.
3) Owners: confirmed — I’ll be the PM lead, Priya will handle the S3 and IAM. Tom will be the legal/compliance contact.
4) Kickoff: May 26 at 10am PT is close but we have a leadership conflict — can we move to May 27 at 11:00 AM PT? If Redwood is not available that day the next window is May 28 morning.

Also: in terms of success criteria, we’ll add a secondary metric — median tokens-per-call reduction (cost signal) since some of our calls are long tail.

Appreciate you putting the mutual action plan together. Once we have the SOC2 summary and a short note on data retention/redaction options we’ll push the sample data.

Best,
Alex
Product Lead, Bluehaven Analytics
alex.morgan@bluehaven.ai

Alex — thanks for the fast reply and the additions. We can absolutely shift kickoff to May 27 at 11:00 AM PT — I’ve tentatively booked that on our side.

Attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (high-level), and a short one-pager on default retention and redaction controls for sandbox workloads. We support token-level redaction and configurable retention windows; for the pilot we recommend anonymizing PII before ingestion, and we can run a redaction pass if you’d like.

Operational notes
- We will provision a sandbox cluster with a dedicated model variant tuned for latency and quantized to reduce unit cost.
- Baseline ingestion will run against a read-only role using the temporary S3 credential you provide (no data persists in customer-managed storage unless you request snapshots).
- For networking, Rishi will be the primary contact if you need IP allowlist or VPC peering details.

Rishi / Kim — can you start the technical kickoff checklist (IP egress list, temp service account template, prompt/eval template)? I’ll share the Drive link with Bluehaven after you confirm.

Next steps for Bluehaven
- Priya: share a short example CSV (id, prompt, expected) by EOD May 27
- Tom: review SOC2 summary and reply with any high-level blocking items
- Alex: confirm the kickoff for May 27 11:00 AM PT (or propose May 28 morning)

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bBluehavenPilotAccess

Ben
